def get_closest_ver(versions: List[str], version: Optional[str], spec:
    SpecifierSet) ->Dict[str, Optional[Union[str, Version]]]:
    if not versions or not version or not spec:
        return {'lower': None, 'upper': None}
    
    parsed_versions = [parse_version(v) for v in versions]
    parsed_version = parse_version(version)
    
    # Find versions that are less than or equal to the current version (lower bounds)
    lower_versions = [v for v in parsed_versions if v <= parsed_version]
    # Find versions that are greater than or equal to the current version (upper bounds)
    upper_versions = [v for v in parsed_versions if v >= parsed_version]
    
    # Get the closest lower version (maximum of those <= current version)
    lower = max(lower_versions) if lower_versions else None
    # Get the closest upper version (minimum of those >= current version)
    upper = min(upper_versions) if upper_versions else None
    
    # Filter out the current version itself from upper and lower bounds
    if upper == parsed_version:
        # Remove the current version from upper bounds
        upper_candidates = [v for v in upper_versions if v > parsed_version]
        upper = min(upper_candidates) if upper_candidates else None
    
    if lower == parsed_version:
        # Remove the current version from lower bounds
        lower_candidates = [v for v in lower_versions if v < parsed_version]
        lower = max(lower_candidates) if lower_candidates else None
    
    return {'lower': lower, 'upper': upper}
